note: Compiled 28 Nov 2026 from github.com/trending (fetched live) and community signals from Hacker News via last30days (Reddit, GitHub and Polymarket data were not available). Web search surfaced no verifiable same-day launches, so news is signal-driven; videos are carried over because no new YouTube ids could be verified.

news.title: LLM agents work for their parent companies, not for you
news.summary: An essay arguing agents should owe duties to their users. Hacker News: 1032 points, 415 comments; many commenters find the argument flimsy.

news.title: Oops I Parsed It Again: Tool-Call Smuggling Against LLM Agents
news.summary: Paper on attacks that smuggle tool calls past agent parsers. Only 3 points on Hacker News, so early, but relevant to anyone writing tool-calling loops.

news.title: Songe: a training engine for your local model, using idle compute
news.summary: Open-source repo for training a local model on spare compute. Hacker News: 238 points, 75 comments.

news.title: End-to-End 4-Bit Training
news.summary: Engineering post on training with 4-bit precision end to end. Hacker News: 24 points, so a quiet but relevant read for training-efficiency topics.

news.title: Faster Retrieval for Better, More Efficient RAG
news.summary: Apple research on speeding up the retrieval step in RAG. Hacker News: 243 points, 40 comments.

news.title: Cerebras launches Disaggregated Inference
news.summary: Cerebras announces disaggregated inference serving. Hacker News: 109 points, 27 comments; useful for understanding prefill/decode separation.

news.title: Announcing the XLA Serving Engine
news.summary: Google announces an open-source serving engine for XLA-based inference. Low Hacker News engagement (3 points).

news.title: Vibecoding an inference chip
news.summary: A blog post on building an inference chip design with AI assistance. Hacker News: 180 points, 80 comments.

news.title: Apple has new Mac app coming to make running local AI models easy
news.summary: Reported: Apple is preparing a Mac app for running local models. Hacker News: 580 points, 572 comments.

news.title: Pete Warden on local AI, open models, voice interfaces and hardware
news.summary: Interview on running models locally and where hardware is heading. Hacker News: 274 points, 254 comments.

news.title: Ask HN: Is Claude Code nerfing AI and agent-harness projects?
news.summary: Discussion thread from developers building agent harnesses. Small so far: 6 points, 5 comments.
